strings.Themes folder hint: Place theme folders inside themes beside the application. Reload after editing. Themes survive updates and uninstalling.
strings.Themes desktop hint: External themes are available in the desktop application.
strings.Theme fallback hint: The theme could not be applied. Built-in appearance is active.
strings.Update try later: Try again later. You can keep working.
strings.Update manual hint: We'll open the download page in your browser.
strings.Update save hint: We'll save your map, install the update, and restart Maploom.
strings.Update ready hint: The update installs automatically, then Maploom restarts.
strings.Update automatic hint: Maploom will let you know when a new version is available.
strings.Update desktop only: Update checks are available in the Maploom desktop application.
strings.Update unpublished: The release is unavailable. The repository may not exist yet or an update has not been published. Try again later.
strings.Update restart hint: Maploom will restart after installation. Save your map first.
strings.Update save first: Save your map and finish the current operation before updating.
strings.Update failed: Check your internet connection and try again. You can keep working.
strings.Update development build: This is a development build. Install a new version from GitHub Releases manually.
strings.Update portable build: This is a portable build. Download the new portable ZIP from GitHub Releases and extract it manually.
strings.Update AppImage only: Update DEB/RPM packages manually. Automatic installation on Linux supports AppImage.
strings.Update app bundle only: Install the application from a DMG or .app archive to use automatic updates.
strings.Variation copy hint: A new variation copies the current one in full, including every floor. The last variation cannot be deleted.
strings.Variations export hint: One ZIP with the main floor of each variation, named after the map without a variation suffix.
strings.Variation floors export hint: Choose a folder: each variation gets a separate ZIP with all its floors. Archive names use the map name and a variation suffix.
strings.The last variation cannot be deleted: The last variation cannot be deleted
strings.Batch export hint: A ZIP archive with one file per floor. Canvas size and alignment are preserved.
strings.Floor export backgrounds hint: The main floor includes its background. Other floors have transparent backgrounds, without lower-floor previews or basement darkness.
strings.Floor transparency requires PNG, WebP, S: Choose PNG, WebP, SVG or VTT to preserve floor transparency.
strings.Main floor is fixed: The main floor is fixed; moving or deleting it is not allowed.
strings.Main floor fixed: The main floor is fixed. It cannot be moved or deleted.
strings.Path smoothness hint: 0 keeps sharp corners; 1 rounds the bends.
strings.Path edit hint: Click an existing path to edit it. Drag points to move them; click a segment to add a point. Delete removes the selected point. Change settings in the inspector or choose another path texture in the library.
strings.Path hint: Click to add points; Enter or double-click finishes. Freehand: drag to draw. Esc cancels.
strings.Scatter hint: Click to place one object; drag to scatter. Esc cancels the stroke.
strings.Scatter selection hint: Click an object to start a set. Shift-click adds or removes objects, including across searches and pages.
strings.Scatter choose assets: Choose objects in the library; Shift-click to add to the set.
strings.Scatter spread hint: Distance between objects in cells. Smaller values give denser placement. Scatter uses free placement.
strings.Scatter palette hint: Click + to choose and add a color. Click a swatch to remove it. An empty palette uses the current color. Only colorable objects are tinted.
strings.Welcome description: Create a project at the size you need or open an existing one.
strings.Resize map hint: Enter cells for each side: “+” expands, “−” crops.
strings.Map dimensions must be 1–512 grid cells: Width and height must be whole numbers from 1 to 512 cells.
strings.Resize content hint: Applies to all levels. Content outside the bounds is hidden and reappears when expanded. Undo (Ctrl+Z) restores the previous size.
strings.Create or open a project first: Create or open a project first
strings.Circle segmentation hint: 6 creates a hexagon; maximum creates a circle.
strings.Geometry hint: Click on an edge or within 2 pixels of it; the marker previews the new point. Drag points to reshape the contour. Delete removes the selected point.
strings.Resize hint: Drag corner handles or set width and height in properties.
strings.Hole hint: Draw inside a floor or room. For polygons: Enter or double-click finishes, Esc cancels. Contours must not intersect.
strings.Draw circle: Drag from the center to the edge to set the circle radius.
strings.Invalid geometry: Invalid contour: check intersections and keep holes inside the outer contour.
strings.Environment color hint: The lighter the color, the brighter the map lighting.
strings.Place the door near a wall: Point at a wall with enough room for the door or window.
strings.Water polygon hint: Click to add points. Enter or double-click to finish; Esc to cancel.
strings.Water brush hint: Drag to paint. Touching waters merge and adopt the last stroke's settings.
strings.Duplicate packs hint: Packs with the same ID are enabled and disabled together. Duplicate files:
strings.Ready · Drop an image, map or pack into: Ready · Drop an image, map or pack into the window
strings.Images imported. Click the map to place: Images imported. Click the map to place an object.
strings.Click a wall to place the asset at its n: Click a wall to place the asset at its native size.
strings.Choose asset: Choose a material in the library
strings.Click to add points. Enter finishes, Esc: Click to add points. Enter finishes, Escape cancels.
strings.Drop images or load a pack. The library: Drop images or load a pack. The library loads images on demand.
strings.Author: Author
strings.Choose available floor and wall assets: Choose available floor and wall assets
strings.Click near a wall long enough for this a: Click near a wall long enough for this asset
strings.DD2VTT includes walls, doors, light sour: DD2VTT includes walls, doors, light sources and PNG. Export one level at a time.
strings.Native VTT map editor. Draw rooms and wa: Native VTT map editor. Draw rooms and walls, enable asset catalogs and place objects.
strings.Wheel to zoom; Space / middle button to: Wheel to zoom; Space / middle button to pan; F to fit. Drag to draw rooms and doors. Click to draw walls, paths and polygons; Enter to finish.
strings.Lights with shadows enabled stop at wall: Lights with shadows enabled stop at walls and doors and pass through windows.
Continuing will replace the current map. Save it or discard the changes.
Disabling hides assets from the picker. Placed objects keep their images.
strings.Translations are edited only in locales/: Translations are edited only in locales/*.json. New files appear after restarting.
strings.Wheel to zoom; Space / middle button to: Wheel to zoom; Space / middle button to pan; F to fit. Drag to draw rooms; click near a wall to place a door. Click to draw walls and polygons; Enter to finish.
Wheel to zoom; Space / middle button to pan; F to fit. Drag to draw rooms; click near a wall to place a door. Click to draw walls and floor outlines; Enter to finish.
strings.Choose a texture in the library on the r: Choose a texture in the library on the right
strings.Choose a floor texture in the library on: Choose a floor texture in the library on the right
strings.Choose a door or window in the library o: Choose a door or window in the library on the right
strings.Choose a wall in the library on the righ: Choose a wall in the library on the right
strings.No matching assets. Load a pack or chang: No matching assets. Load a pack or change the search.
strings.This object keeps its original colors: This object keeps its original colors
strings.Import hint: Add a folder in Asset catalogs and enable it for this map.
strings.Selection hint: Select an element to adjust it. Shift adds to the selection; drag a box to select a group.
strings.Name: Name
strings.New description: A blank canvas for your next story.
strings.Export description: Ready for your tabletop, print or VTT.
strings.VTT hint: DD2VTT includes the image, walls, doors, windows and lights.
strings.VTT windows hint: If Foundry shows windows as doors, disable Openable Windows in Universal Battlemap Importer settings and import the map again.
strings.No warnings: No warnings. You're ready to create.
strings.Recovery description: Restore your project from the latest backup.
strings.Autosave hint: Backups are created every 5 minutes. The last 5 versions per project are stored in %LOCALAPPDATA%/Maploom/backups.
strings.Preview hint: File operations are available in the Tauri desktop app.
strings.Fabric hint: Select assets to create a portable library.
strings.Place: Click on the map to place
strings.Draw shape: Click points · Enter to finish · Esc to cancel
strings.Select hint: Select · Shift for groups · Drag to move · Wheel to rotate objects · Ctrl + wheel to zoom
strings.Object wheel hint: Wheel rotates objects during placement and selection by 15° · Shift + wheel by 1° · Ctrl + wheel to zoom
strings.Pan hint: Drag to pan · Scroll to zoom
strings.Paint hint: Click or drag to paint on the map
strings.Empty canvas: Start with a room or terrain
strings.Empty description: Choose a tool on the left. Your world starts here.
strings.Confirm delete: Delete selection? You can undo this action.
strings.GPU unavailable: The map requires hardware WebGL 2. Check WebView2 acceleration and the graphics driver.
strings.GPU context lost: GPU context lost. Waiting for rendering to recover.
strings.Wall snap hint: Snap the visible image to a wall with a 5 map pixel gap. Also works when moving objects.
strings.Silhouette unavailable: Could not read the image outline. Try placing the object again.
strings.Placement changed: The map changed while reading the image. Try placing the object again.
strings.Text edit hint: Click text to edit it, or empty space to create a label. Ctrl+Enter applies the text.
strings.Text move hint: Drag a label on the map. This mode does not create labels.
strings.Font fallback hint: This font is not installed. The bundled font is used; your original choice is preserved.
strings.Local fonts desktop hint: Installed fonts are available in the desktop app.
strings.Text padding hint: The box fits the text automatically with 4 map pixels of padding on every side. The border is drawn outside.
strings.Label editing hint: Label settings are in the tool panel on the left.
strings.Roof manual hint: Click to draw a bent ridge line. Enter or double-click to finish; Esc to cancel. Width sets the distance between the eaves.
strings.Roof quickbox hint: Drag a rectangle. The ridge follows its longer side; the rectangle sets the roof width.
strings.No cave styles: Enable default assets or connect a cave asset pack.
strings.Cave hint: Drag to dig a cave or blast through its floor and rock boundary. Rooms take priority where they overlap; cave rock cannot host doors.
strings.Prefab selection hint: Select 2–1000 objects on the map, then create a prefab. Only objects can be included.
strings.Prefab placement hint: Choose a prefab and click the map to place it on the active layer. Scale and rotation apply to the whole composition. Placed objects remain editable.
strings.Prefab export hint: A .mloom_prefab file includes definitions and all images. Import .mloom_prefab or .dungeondraft_prefab; DD files need connected textures.
